text: Heads up, seeing a new phishing wave hitting our domain. Spoofed HR emails, subject lines about year-end bonus reviews
Already flagged 14 instances in the last hour. Pretty convincing templates too, they're pulling real names from LinkedIn
How many users clicked so far
3 that I can confirm. Credential harvesting page, looks like a fake SSO login
Already pushed those accounts for password resets
You want me to pull the click-through patterns? Can cross-reference with the user behaviour baselines I have
Ya that would be useful. Want to see if there's a department cluster or if it's random targeting
Give me the sender domains and timestamps, I'll run it
Sending now
[file: phish_indicators_27nov.csv]
Ok so finance and HR are getting hit hardest. Not random, they're targeting people with admin access or payroll permissions
Makes sense with the bonus theme
Also the timing clusters around 09:00-10:00 and then again at 14:00. Like they know when people are most likely to check email
Probably tested it. These guys aren't amateurs
Im gonna push an org-wide alert and add the domains to the blocklist. Can you put together a quick summary for the incident report
Sure, give me 30
[file: phishing_incident_summary_27nov.pdf]
Included the targeting pattern and the behavioural anomalies. Should be enough for management
Perfect. Blocklist is updated, alert went out 10 min ago
Gonna keep monitoring over the weekend. Wouldn't be surprised if they switch templates
Ya let me know if you see a second wave, I'll adjust the detection model
Already seeing a variant. Same infrastructure but now it's a "December leave approval" theme
Lol they're fast
Added to blocklist. Only 2 deliveries before the filter caught it this time
The model flagged those too on my end so at least that's working
Nice
Quiet now. Think they've moved on for the day
Cool. I'll check the logs again in the morning just in case
Checked the overnight logs. No new deliveries after about 20:00 last night
Same on my end. Blocklist holding
Wouldn't relax yet tho, Sunday night into Monday morning is prime time for round 2
Ya I was thinking the same. They'll probably hit again when people come back online Monday
I'm going to retrain the model with yesterday's data so it catches the template variations faster
Good idea. The leave approval one was close enough to legit that I nearly missed it on first glance
Model's updated. Also noticed something weird in the data from yesterday
One of the 3 users who clicked actually clicked twice. Different times, same link
Who
Thabo from finance
Lol that guy. Second time this quarter
His password reset went through at least?
Ya confirmed
Might need to flag him for extra training. Not being harsh but twice in one day is rough
I'll add it to the report
Power just flickered here. Loadshedding schedule said we were clear today
Stage 2 came back this morning apparently
Great
You on UPS?
Ya but it only gives me like 45 min. Should be fine if it's stage 2
Cool
Still quiet on the phishing front. Starting to think they might wait till Monday like we said
Yep nothing flagged on my side either
